references.source: Asian Development Bank (ADB). 2014. Solid Waste Management in the Pacific - Tonga Country Snapshot.
references.notes: The island of Tongatapu, which the city of Nuku'alofa is the primary population centre, generates about 10,000 tons of household MSW each year.
This value was calculated based on the total MSW generated per year divided by 365 (days in a year), and the population if it was provided in the same report as MSW generation

references.source: J-prism II. 2022. Solid Waste Management Country Profile: Tonga. SPREP PROE Virtual Library.
references.notes: The Tapuhia landfill is located about 11 km from the capital city of Nuku'alofa and was originally the site of a quarry.
